description: Historical National Bank of Romania (BNR) official FX reference rates, parsed from XML. With no arguments (or period="10days") returns the last 10 published business days. Pass year=YYYY (e.g. 2024) to return every published day in that calendar year. Returns an array of daily entries, each { date, rates:[{currency, value, multiplier}] }. Each rate is RON per `multiplier` units of the currency; per-1-unit rate = value / multiplier. Currencies are ISO 4217 codes. Note the currency set can vary across dates.

period.description: Use "10days" for the last 10 business days (default). Ignored if year is set.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2024. Returns the full-year file for that year.

name: bnr_exchange_rates_history
title: Bnr Exchange Rates History
